title: Business English Conversation 17:   Lost Luggage
content: 1. luggage: bags or suitcases that one takes while traveling - The family had a lot of luggage. - The airline lost my luggage. I am so angry. 2. to locate something: to find something - The airline said they will try to locate my luggage as soon as possible. - We are trying to locate the missing document. 3. right away: immediately - I will find it for you right away. - She said she will send it right away.
